name: Andre Williams
about_me: I'm Andre, an emergency department nurse at Michigan Medicine for twelve years. I advise a couple of health startups. I'm looking for paid clinical advisory work.
goals: Land two paid clinical advisory roles

debriefs.text: Nia Thompson, an ICU nurse, is building a shift-handoff app. I agreed to be her clinical advisor.
Colin O'Brien from Shiftly interviewed me about nurse staffing. I told him nurses need to see pay up front.
Bethany Kowalski, our nurse manager, said the pilot program needs nurse reviewers and might pay a stipend.
Mira Joshi, CEO of Clearpath Meds, asked if I'd review their discharge workflow. I promised to send her notes by next week.
